fullDescription: A portrait single-field PROMO / enrollment FLYER staked entirely on ONE saturated cobalt #1a34d6 field with no chrome — color and big ARCHIVO BLACK type carry all the recognition. A small yellow eyebrow ('Enrollment open'), a massive unboxed headline set directly on the field with one word/line dropped to yellow ('Learn / to ship / in 6 weeks'), a soft off-cobalt radial glow from the top-right, and a faint film-grain overlay. ALL functional content lives in ONE floating soft-white #eef1ff card near the bottom: an offer title, a one-line value description, and a cobalt pill CTA closed by a yellow circular chevron dot. The single warm yellow #ffd23f is rationed to the offer only. All CSS/SVG, no photos. Reusable for course/cohort enrollment, bootcamp/workshop promos, sale/discount announcements, product drops, and any single-offer flyer that should read as a poster.
prompt:
## Resumo
A portrait (1058x1497, print/poster feel) single-field PROMO / enrollment FLYER, generically branded as a weekend build-cohort ad. THE WHOLE VIEWPORT IS ONE SATURATED FIELD: cobalt #1a34d6 fills edge to edge with NO nav, NO chrome, NO container — color plus type IS the brand. ACCENT DISCIPLINE: exactly ONE warm yellow #ffd23f, rationed to the offer signals only (the eyebrow, the hook word/line, the CTA chevron dot) and appearing nowhere else; a soft off-cobalt radial glow #4a63ff bleeds from the TOP-RIGHT and a faint film-grain overlay (~6% opacity) keeps the flat field tactile. TYPE: everything display is ARCHIVO BLACK (heavy grotesque; Anton / Montserrat 900 fallback, never a normal-width sans). Top zone, set DIRECTLY on the field: a small yellow Archivo Black eyebrow ('ENROLLMENT OPEN'), then a MASSIVE headline in soft off-white #eef1ff at poster scale (line-height ~0.86) with ONE line dropped to yellow — 'Learn / to ship' in off-white then 'in 6 weeks' in yellow. Bottom zone: ALL functional content consolidated into ONE floating card — soft off-white #eef1ff fill, generous radius (~3cqw), holding a deep-navy #141b6b heavy title ('Weekend build cohort'), a muted-indigo #4650b8 one-line value description, and a cobalt #1a34d6 PILL CTA (white text 'Reserve a seat — $290') closed on the right by a yellow #ffd23f circular chevron DOT. The card is the only usable surface; the field above is pure atmosphere. All type + shapes CSS/SVG; no photos, no illustration.

## Estilo Visual
Design a portrait single-field promo / enrollment FLYER. Fill the WHOLE viewport with one saturated cobalt #1a34d6 field — no nav, no chrome, no outer container. Add a soft off-cobalt radial glow #4a63ff bleeding from the top-right and a faint film-grain overlay (~6%). Set all display type in ARCHIVO BLACK (heavy grotesque; Anton / Montserrat 900 fallback, never a normal-width sans). Top, directly on the field: a small yellow #ffd23f eyebrow, then a MASSIVE headline in soft off-white #eef1ff at poster scale (line-height ~0.86) with ONE line dropped to yellow ('Learn / to ship / in 6 weeks'). Bottom: consolidate ALL functional content into ONE floating soft-white #eef1ff card with a generous radius — a deep-navy #141b6b heavy title, a muted-indigo #4650b8 one-line value description, and a cobalt #1a34d6 pill CTA in white closed by a yellow #ffd23f circular chevron dot. Ration the yellow to the offer ONLY; use soft off-white, never pure #fff, on the field. All CSS/SVG, no photos.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Cobalt field + glow + grain
Fill the entire portrait viewport edge to edge with saturated cobalt #1a34d6 — no nav, no header bar, no outer frame. Add ONE soft radial glow in a lighter off-cobalt #4a63ff bleeding in from the TOP-RIGHT (large, ~70% radius, low opacity) so the field has directional light. Over the whole field lay a faint film-grain / fractal-noise overlay at ~6% opacity so the flat fill reads as tactile atmosphere, not a default background. No photos, no illustration.

### Eyebrow + massive headline on the field
Near the top, set directly on the field (no container): a small ARCHIVO BLACK eyebrow in warm yellow #ffd23f ('Enrollment open'). Below it a MASSIVE Archivo Black headline at poster scale (line-height ~0.86, tight tracking) in soft off-white #eef1ff — 'Learn' / 'to ship' — then a smaller trailing line dropped to yellow #ffd23f ('in 6 weeks') as the hook. Never box the headline; it lives on the color.

### Floating functional card
Pin ONE floating card near the bottom margin: soft off-white #eef1ff fill, generous radius (~3cqw), comfortable padding. Inside, stacked: a heavy Archivo Black title in deep navy #141b6b ('Weekend build cohort'); a one-line value description in muted indigo #4650b8 ('Six Saturdays, one real product shipped. Small group, live reviews, no lectures.'); then a full-width cobalt #1a34d6 PILL CTA (rounded, white bold text 'Reserve a seat — $290') with a yellow #ffd23f circular chevron DOT ('->') pinned to its right edge. This card carries ALL actionable content.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Single saturated color field (the whole canvas) — One loud cobalt owning the entire viewport as the brand.
Fill the entire flyer with one saturated cobalt #1a34d6 and remove all chrome — no nav, no frame, no secondary panels above the card. The color plus a heavy grotesque headline carries recognition with zero UI scaffolding. Add only a soft off-cobalt radial glow from one corner and a faint grain so the fill reads as atmosphere. This single decision IS the identity.

### Unboxed poster headline with accent drop — A massive Archivo Black headline set directly on the field with one line dropped to the accent.
Set the headline in ARCHIVO BLACK (heavy grotesque; Anton / Montserrat 900 fallback, never a normal-width sans) at poster scale (line-height ~0.86) directly on the color field with no container, in soft off-white #eef1ff. Drop exactly ONE word or trailing line to the warm yellow accent #ffd23f as the hook. The unboxed scale + the single accent-drop is the whole hierarchy.

### Floating functional card — One soft-white card carrying every actionable element over the expressive field.
Concentrate ALL functional content into a single floating card — soft off-white #eef1ff (never pure white), generous radius, near the bottom margin — holding a deep-navy heavy title, a muted-indigo one-line value description, and a pill CTA. Let the field above stay pure atmosphere. The split keeps the flyer both loud and usable.

### Pill CTA with chevron dot — A cobalt pill button closed by a rationed-yellow circular chevron.
Build the CTA as a full-width cobalt #1a34d6 PILL (rounded) with white bold text ('Reserve a seat — $290') and a yellow #ffd23f circular DOT pinned to its right holding a chevron ('->') in deep navy. The yellow dot is the ONE place the accent touches the CTA — do not repeat yellow elsewhere in the card.

## Notas Especiais
ACCENT DISCIPLINE IS THE CRAFT: exactly ONE warm yellow #ffd23f, rationed to the offer signals ONLY — the eyebrow, the dropped hook line, and the CTA chevron dot. If yellow appears anywhere else the system reads as decoration instead of a signal.,OFF-WHITE, NEVER PURE #fff: text and the card use soft off-white #eef1ff, not #ffffff; pure white on a saturated field always looks like an untouched browser default. Card body text is muted indigo #4650b8; card title is deep navy #141b6b.,FONTS: all display type in Archivo Black (fallback Anton, then Montserrat 900 — never a normal-width sans). Load from Google Fonts. The heavy grotesque at poster scale is doing the identity work; a lighter weight kills it.,NO real external reference was sourced (matching galleries were Cloudflare-walled); this is a NEW composition anchored to [[DP-1307]] (config.figma.com) and [[DP-1309]] (charm.sh) corpus lineage. No `DP-1805-ref.png` was created — inventing a reference image would violate the pipeline's iron rule.,Canvas is fixed 1058x1497 portrait (1cqw = 10.58px if authoring in container units). Swap copy/offer freely — the structure (field + unboxed headline + one floating card + pill CTA) holds for any enrollment, sale, cohort, bootcamp, product-drop, or single-offer flyer.
